title: Introduce upgrade rollback safety-net and emergency patch for on-prem operator config drift
creator: Maya Chen
description: Multiple customers on Private/VPC and air-gapped on-prem installs reported failed operator upgrades that left control-plane resources in partial state and caused reconciliation loops. This ticket tracks the investigation, a rollback-safety feature to avoid destructive post-upgrade reconciliation (rollback-sentinel), and a rapid emergency patch to short-circuit the operator's helm-hook ordering issue and config-ghost reapplication.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Install operator vX.Y.Z in a private cluster with custom CRD patches applied via Kustomize
2) Run `helm upgrade` to operator vX.Y.Z+1 where new pre-upgrade CRD conversion hooks run
3) Observe operator pod restart during post-upgrade reconcile (kube-probe flapping and transient leader-election),
4) Check `redwood-operator` logs: repeated `Reconcile failed: conflict updating spec` and `configmap checksum mismatch` messages
5) Some clusters end up with stale node-agent DaemonSet annotations and can no longer complete rolling restart, requiring manual intervention.
root_cause: Helm hook ordering + operator startup race: when the operator pod restarts during the helm post-upgrade hook window, the operator's first reconcile run can reapply older generated resources because the upgrade path depended on a one-time migration hook that didn't set a durable sentinel.

Config-ghost: generated ConfigMap checksums in existing clusters were not marked immutable; during reconciliation the operator treated absence of migration-sentinel as 'apply previous generator' causing drift back to pre-upgrade templates.
Leader-election jitter + liveness probe sensitivity (probe interval too aggressive) caused duplicate reconciles which surfaced write conflicts and left partial updates.
mitigation_taken: 2026-03-06: Issued customer mitigation steps to affected clusters — scale operator to 0, manually remove `redwood-migration` temporary CRs, then scale back up (documented in support playbook).
2026-03-07: Feature-flagged quick patch that short-circuits generator reapplication when `upgrade-sentinel` annotation exists (deployed to hosted control plane for verification).
2026-03-08: Provided a rollback script and Helm rollback guidance to customers who could not progress (script placed in support-runbooks).
planned_work: Add a robust rollback-sentinel (immutable CR/annotation) written atomically by Helm post-upgrade hook so the operator will not reapply pre-migration generated resources if sentinel is present.
Harden liveness/readiness probe settings and add jitter to leader-election intervals to avoid startup reconciling races.
Introduce an operator-level 'dry-check' mode that runs pre- and post-upgrade validations and emits a non-destructive report back to the Helm hook so upgrades can fail fast before destructive changes.

Cut operator-2026.03.1 emergency patch that: (a) checks for `upgrade-sentinel` before generator reapply; (b) ignores checksum mismatches when ephemeral-migration flag set; (c) emits a reconciliation reason code for easier postmortems.
qa_and_validation_plan: Create a reproducible e2e test in CI that simulates the Helm upgrade hook ordering under pod restarts (inject chaos to operator during helm upgrade).
Run patch through private staging cluster with real customer manifests (with permission) and validate no generator reapplication or DaemonSet drift.
Coordinate with Support to trial the patch with two low-risk customers first, observe metrics for 48 hours, then proceed to broader rollout.
